faq.title: Frequently
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SIMPLARA and LUMI

questions.question: Do I need to buy new clothes?
questions.answer: No. SIMPLARA first helps you use what you already have. The entire purpose is to help you rediscover and maximize your existing wardrobe before buying anything new.

questions.question: Is it only for women?
questions.answer: No. SIMPLARA is for men and women who want to look more stylish and build outfits faster. Our AI works equally well for all clothing types and styles.

questions.question: How does the app understand my clothes?
questions.answer: You upload clothing photos, and our AI classifies items by category, color, style, seasonality and other parameters. The more items you add, the better LUMI understands your wardrobe and can suggest combinations.

questions.question: Is LUMI a stylist?
questions.answer: LUMI is an AI wardrobe assistant. It helps create outfits based on your existing wardrobe, weather, and preferences, but does not judge your appearance or try to change your personal style.

questions.question: Can I get help from a real person?
questions.answer: Yes. A separate wardrobe classification service with expert stylists is planned. They can help you properly organize and upload your wardrobe for the best AI recommendations.

questions.question: What is the Founders Club?
questions.answer: FIRST 888 (Founders Club) is a one-time membership limited to 888 spots. First 88 members pay $5, then price increases. You get a Founder Badge, early access, closed community, influence on product development, special launch terms, event invitations, collectible merch, and your name on the Founder Wall.

questions.question: When is the launch?
questions.answer: The product is preparing for MVP testing. Join the Founders Club now to secure your spot and get priority access when we launch.

questions.question: Will SIMPLARA be free?
questions.answer: We're planning a free tier with core features and premium subscriptions for advanced features like wardrobe classification, LUMI Room customization, and expert consultations.

questions.question: How is my data protected?
questions.answer: Your wardrobe data is private and secure. We never share your personal information or clothing items with third parties. You have full control over your data.

questions.question: What makes SIMPLARA different from other fashion apps?
questions.answer: Unlike generic AI stylists that show random outfit ideas, SIMPLARA works exclusively with YOUR real clothes. It's a complete wardrobe ecosystem with AI, gamification, community features, and smart recommendations.

questions.question: Can I use SIMPLARA for special occasions?
questions.answer: Absolutely! LUMI can suggest outfits for work, dates, parties, travel, and any special occasion. Just specify the context and LUMI will find the perfect combination from your wardrobe.

faq.contactUs: We're here to help! Reach out to us and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
